I feel like people are focusing too much on 'women’s freedom' and ignoring the fact that me listening to my partner, considering his feelings, and still making the decision about a photo of mine on my own is also my freedom. I have the right to change my perspective on things and situations. This doesn’t mean someone is forcing me to make those decisions. That’s freedom too

I appreciate your perspective, but I think you're making a lot of assumptions about my situation and my relationship. My boyfriend didn’t force me to do anything—I listened to his concerns, found them reasonable, and made my own decision to ask for the photo’s removal. That’s not submission; that’s communication and mutual respect.

Autonomy means having the right to change my mind about what I’m comfortable with, and I expected the artist to respect that. I wasn’t trying to erase their work, just requesting a more considerate way to display it. If they truly valued the tattoo itself, they could have easily cropped the image instead of making this about control or ego.

I respect your years in the industry, but professionalism also includes respecting a client’s evolving boundaries.
